## Punctuation is stored as written

There is no smart punctuation. Quotation marks, hyphen runs, and periods are
stored as written, and typographic replacement is consumer policy, as every
other rendering choice is. The dialect's base module states the rule; its own
example comes first, and the inputs of cmark's `smart_punct.txt` follow it,
kept so that every substitution that mode used to make is asserted not to
happen. The cmark gate replays these inputs against cmark without `--smart`,
where the two agree byte for byte.

```````````````````````````````` example
"quotes" 'single' -- --- ---- ... a\"b
.
Document scope=1:1..1:38 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:38 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:38 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\"quotes\" 'single' -- --- ---- ... a\"b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Quotes are never matched: an opening quote, a closing quote, and an apostrophe
are the same byte, stored as written.

```````````````````````````````` example
"Hello," said the spider.
"'Shelob' is my name."
.
Document scope=1:1..2:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\"Hello,\" said the spider." children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:26..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=2:1..2:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\"'Shelob' is my name.\"" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
'A', 'B', and 'C' are letters.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:30 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:30 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:30 anchor=null attributes={} literal="'A', 'B', and 'C' are letters." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
'Oak,' 'elm,' and 'beech' are names of trees.
So is 'pine.'
.
Document scope=1:1..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:45 anchor=null attributes={} literal="'Oak,' 'elm,' and 'beech' are names of trees." children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:46..1:46 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=2:1..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="So is 'pine.'" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
'He said, "I want to go."'
.
Document scope=1:1..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal="'He said, \"I want to go.\"'" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An apostrophe is the same byte:

```````````````````````````````` example
Were you alive in the 70's?
.
Document scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Were you alive in the 70's?" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Here is some quoted '`code`' and a "[quoted link](url)".
.
Document scope=1:1..1:56 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:56 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Here is some quoted '" children=0
    ├── Code scope=1:22..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="code" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:28..1:36 anchor=null attributes={} literal="' and a \"" children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:37..1:54 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("url") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:38..1:48 anchor=null attributes={} literal="quoted link" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:55..1:56 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\"." children=0
````````````````````````````````

A quote that cmark's smart mode would have read as an apostrophe by matching
stays as it was written:

```````````````````````````````` example
'tis the season to be 'jolly'
.
Document scope=1:1..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} literal="'tis the season to be 'jolly'" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Several apostrophes in one run of text stay apostrophes:

```````````````````````````````` example
'We'll use Jane's boat and John's truck,' Jenna said.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:53 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:53 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:53 anchor=null attributes={} literal="'We'll use Jane's boat and John's truck,' Jenna said." children=0
````````````````````````````````

An unmatched double quote is a double quote:

```````````````````````````````` example
"A paragraph with no closing quote.

"Second paragraph by same speaker, in fiction."
.
Document scope=1:1..3:47 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:35 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:35 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\"A paragraph with no closing quote." children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:47 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:47 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\"Second paragraph by same speaker, in fiction.\"" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A quote after `]` or `)` is the same byte as anywhere else:

```````````````````````````````` example
[a]'s b'
.
Document scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[a]'s b'" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An escaped quote is the quote it escapes, exactly as an unescaped one is:

```````````````````````````````` example
\"This is not smart.\"
This isn\'t either.
5\'8\"
.
Document scope=1:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\"This is not smart.\"" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:23..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:1..2:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="This isn't either." children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=2:20..2:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="5'8\"" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Hyphen runs of every length are hyphens:

```````````````````````````````` example
Some dashes:  em---em
en--en
em --- em
en -- en
2--3
.
Document scope=1:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=9
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Some dashes:  em---em" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:22..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="en--en" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=2:7..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=3:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="em --- em" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=3:10..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=4:1..4:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="en -- en" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=4:9..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="2--3" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The inputs cmark's smart mode splits into em and en dashes are stored whole:

```````````````````````````````` example
one-
two--
three---
four----
five-----
six------
seven-------
eight--------
nine---------
thirteen-------------.
.
Document scope=1:1..10:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..10:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=19
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="one-" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="two--" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=2:6..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=3:1..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="three---" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=3:9..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=4:1..4:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="four----" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=4:9..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=5:1..5:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="five-----" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=5:10..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=6:1..6:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="six------" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=6:10..6:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=7:1..7:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="seven-------" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=7:13..7:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=8:1..8:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="eight--------" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=8:14..8:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=9:1..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="nine---------" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=9:14..9:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=10:1..10:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="thirteen-------------." children=0
````````````````````````````````

An escaped hyphen is a hyphen, exactly as an unescaped one is:

```````````````````````````````` example
Escaped hyphens: \-- \-\-\-.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Escaped hyphens: -- ---." children=0
````````````````````````````````

Three periods are three periods:

```````````````````````````````` example
Ellipses...and...and....
.
Document scope=1:1..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Ellipses...and...and...." children=0
````````````````````````````````

An escaped period is a period, exactly as an unescaped one is:

```````````````````````````````` example
No ellipses\.\.\.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="No ellipses..." children=0
````````````````````````````````
